name: She Spies
description: She Spies is an action-adventure television show that ran from September 9, 2002 until May 17, 2004, in two seasons. The show was sold into syndication but the first four episodes premiered on the NBC network, whose syndication arm was one of the producers. Disappointing ratings during the show's second season led to its cancellation after season two ended. She Spies bore noticeable production and directive similarities with Charlie's Angels.

videos.title: First Episode
videos.overview: In their debut mission, reformed criminals Cassie, Shane, and D.D. must protect a controversial former presidential candidate during the taping of his talk show. Can they navigate the cutthroat worlds of politics and showbiz to uncover a conspiracy?

videos.title: The Martini Shot
videos.overview: Haute couture has never been hauter than when the ladies of She Spies infiltrate the fashion industry to capture a notorious fashion pirate. Going undercover in a modeling agency, our heroines discover a web of blackmail involving two supermodels!

videos.title: Poster Girl
videos.overview: The She Spies team investigates a suspicious children's hospital charity and discover a web of deceit involving millions in stolen donations, smuggled diamonds, and a mysterious poster child who may not be what she seems.

videos.title: Daddy's Girl
videos.overview: The She Spies team must protect a diplomat's rebellious daughter, but when she vanishes, they uncover more than just a kidnapping plot. As Cassie confronts her own family demons, the team discovers sometimes emotional wounds are the hardest to heal.

videos.title: Fondles
videos.overview: When an agent is murdered at a singles community, the team goes undercover to catch a dangerous foreign operative known only as "The Player." As our heroines infiltrate the complex, they discover a web of secrets behind the innocent facade.

videos.title: Ice Man
videos.overview: When the She Spies team is tasked with tracking down a mysterious assassin known only as "The Ice Man," they find themselves caught in a web of comedy and danger. As they go undercover at a comedy club to unravel a money laundering scheme.

videos.title: Three Women and a Baby
videos.overview: When a baby appears on their doorstep, the team must protect her from a dangerous father. As they juggle childcare with investigation, the agents discover that keeping mother and child safe will require all their skills...and maybe a few lullabies.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: When a vengeful bomber transforms the She Spies' home into a deadly maze of explosive traps, the team must find a way to escape their own fortress before an unwitting cable guy arrives and triggers a catastrophic chain reaction.

videos.title: Spies vs. Spy
videos.overview: The team goes undercover at a high-profile wedding, only to face their toughest opponent yet - Jack's ex-protégé Tanya, the original She Spy. Now they must outsmart someone who knows all their tricks while protecting the bride.

videos.title: Perilyzed
videos.overview: When a mysterious stuffed frog appears in their office, the She Spies team faces a deadly crisis as they begin experiencing paralysis and blindness. As their symptoms worsen, they must solve who sent this toxic gift - before it's too late.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: When D.D. begins acting suspiciously, the rest of the She Spies team must investigate their teammate for possible treason. But after she disappears, the race is on to uncover the truth and save their friend before it is too late.

videos.title: The Girl with the Broken Heart
videos.overview: At a medical convention, Cassie faces her ex-fiancé who's now dating their smuggler target. As she struggles to protect him while maintaining her cover, she discovers shocking truths about their past relationship and must confront old wounds.

videos.title: You Don't Know Jack
videos.overview: When an assassin known as La Puma targets the She Spies team in their own home, they discover a shocking truth - their trusted handler Jack may be leading a dangerous double life. Now, the team must uncover whether their mentor has been compromised.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: When the team is tasked with investigating a software company suspected of illegally exporting missile defense technology, they go undercover to get close to the three partners. But will the mission be jeopardized by unexpected feelings?

videos.title: While You Were Out
videos.overview: Cassie, D.D. and Shane go undercover at a plastics company to protect its CEO from death threats, only to discover a complex web of workplace politics and hidden agendas that challenges their assumptions about power and gender.

videos.title: Daze of Future Past
videos.overview: While recovering from a mysterious injury under the care of an enigmatic doctor, Jack must piece together fragmented memories of his team's last mission, only to discover his "recovery" may be part of a deadly deception aimed at the She Spies team.

videos.title: The Replacement
videos.overview: A jewel thief kidnaps Cassie, forcing Shane and D.D. to work with a new agent to stop a museum heist and save their friend. The case reveals unexpected connections between the world of high fashion and international crime.

videos.title: Damsels in De-Stress
videos.overview: When the team is sent to an exclusive government spa to decompress after a mission, they discover their "relaxing retreat" is anything but. It seems someone at the spa has a deadly agenda - and knows far too much about their recent cases.

videos.title: Learning to Fly
videos.overview: She Spies goes airborne to protect an animal rights activist from assassins. But with one agent drugged and another terrified of flying, solving this mile-high mystery becomes a race against time - if they can just keep the plane in the air.

videos.title: We'll Be Right Back
videos.overview: When Shane's old friend Kelly decides to be cryogenically frozen alongside his deceased girlfriend, it sets off a chain of events that uncovers a sinister plot involving the cryogenics lab and a media mogul with a very dark secret.

videos.title: Rane of Terror
videos.overview: When their laid-back boss Jack gets suddenly reassigned to Rome, the She Spies find themselves under the strict command of the mysterious Mr. Cross. Their first mission: protect arrogant pop star Rane Kennedy from a kidnapping threat.

videos.title: Last Man Standing
videos.overview: When Cross' former colleague is murdered, it leads to a high-stakes confrontation with a dangerous arms dealer with a stolen bio-toxin. Soon, the She Spies infiltrate an exclusive auction where criminals bid for the weapon.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: When their colleague goes missing, the team uncovers a plot involving a dating agency that targets government employees. As Cassie infiltrates the agency and Shane poses as a recruit, D.D. unexpectedly plays matchmaker for the quirky clientele.

videos.title: Gone Bad
videos.overview: When Shane reunites with her ex-partner in crime, her fellow She Spies fear she's slipping back to her criminal ways. But a missing religious artifact, international intrigue, and a suspicious cable repairman reveal nothing is what it seems.

videos.title: Date to Mate
videos.overview: When terrorists take over a dating reality show, the She Spies find themselves trapped in a high-stakes hostage situation. As D.D. and Shane work from the inside, Cassie goes undercover to infiltrate the terrorist group.

videos.title: Crossed Out
videos.overview: When Cross is arrested for the Chairman's murder, the She Spies must balance their duty to a new boss with their loyalty to the man who gave them a second chance. But proving Cross' innocence gets complicated when they are branded as traitors.

videos.title: Cover Me
videos.overview: When a woman is killed in a bus accident while impersonating Cassie, the She Spies discover an elaborate plot involving stolen identities and international terrorism. Now Cassie has to step into her double's life to solve the case.

videos.title: Love Kills
videos.overview: When the She Spies infiltrate a couples therapy retreat to protect a diplomat, they must navigate relationship drama, family complications, and deadly assassins while discovering that matters of the heart can be as dangerous as any mission.

videos.title: Off With Her Head
videos.overview: When someone places an explosive necklace around Cassie's neck during her birthday celebration, the She Spies find themselves in a desperate race against time when the mysterious attackers demand the release of a dangerous Russian operative.

videos.title: Message from Kassar
videos.overview: When the She Spies receive a cryptic message from a mathematician, they embark on a mission to locate its sender. Their search leads them to a remote cabin where they encounter Kayla, a fierce ex-commando protecting the genius she loves.

videos.title: Spies Gone Wild
videos.overview: When Duncan falls for a disguised princess, the She Spies must rescue her from criminals using beach contests to select trafficking victims. The mission becomes complicated when they discover her bodyguard has secretly loved her since childhood.

videos.title: The White Chollima
videos.overview: Cassie learns her long-dead mother is actually a brainwashed North Korean operative. As her mother pursues an assassination mission with no memory of her past life, the team races to stop her while trying to restore her real memories.

videos.title: Leotards and Lies
videos.overview: The She Spies use a high-tech surveillance baby doll to investigate a suspected traitor and his daughter's apparent kidnapping. As they uncover an elaborate scheme, one agent must face her fears about motherhood while Duncan creates an ideal spy boyfriend.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: Working to reunite a defected Cuban scientist with his daughter, the She Spies discover layers of deception that force them to question everything, while one team member's romance with an ambitious journalist threatens it all.

videos.title: The Gift
videos.overview: When a psychic joins the She Spies as they investigate stolen military technology, they must decide whether to trust her odd visions. Their search leads them to an unexpected location as they race to recover the tech before it can be sold overseas.

videos.title: London Calling
videos.overview: When the She Spies accidentally disrupt a British operation to recover a stolen diamond, one must pose as the wife of a British agent at a high-stakes gambling party. But their mission becomes complicated by unexpected feelings.

videos.title: Stranded
videos.overview: After crash-landing on a remote deserted island with a dangerous prisoner, the She Spies fight for survival while Duncan tries to convince authorities to continue searching for the lost trio. But are our heroines alone on the island?

videos.title: Witness Protection
videos.overview: The She Spies protect a witness and his troublesome eight-year-old son at their beach house after other witnesses are killed in an explosion. As they investigate the attack, they discover dangerous secrets that put everyone at risk.

videos.title: Wedding of the Century
videos.overview: The She Spies protect a congressman's rushed wedding after an assassination attempt. As they investigate threats surrounding the ceremony and deal with an aggressive wedding planner, they discover an obsessed suspect with dangerous motives.

videos.title: Remember When
videos.overview: When a mission goes sideways, Shane falls victim to a mysterious drug that begins erasing her memories one by one. As the clock ticks and her past slips away, Cassie and DD must join forces with an enigmatic new partner to track down the cure.
